items.title: fix(ui): keep visible chat messages authoritative over late snapshot …
items.summary: fix(ui): keep visible chat messages authoritative over late snapshot hydration (#128146) * fix(ui): keep visible chat rows authoritative over late stored snapshots The stored-snapshot ordering fence only detected replacements through the in-memory snapshot cache. Live appends and optimistic first-turn handoffs update the visible rows without populating that cache, so a delayed IndexedDB read could still replace newer visible messages with stale stored content. Skip persistent hydration whenever the pane already has visible rows for the session. * test(ui): split stored-snapshot hydration coverage into its own file chat-pane.test.ts had grown past the lint line budget. Move the persistent-snapshot hydration tests (including the new ordering-fence regression) into chat-pane-snapshot-hydration.test.ts and share the pane initialization fixtures through the existing test support module. * fix(ui): merge stored history with pending prompts * test(agents): make workspace bootstrap cache test deterministic
